status_rule: gating only when the Wilson 95% lower bounds of violation recall and specificity both reach the bar in that language group

validation.verdict: fails the recall bar on the lower bound
validation.raters: two native-speaker raters per call, adjudicated

routing_when_advisory: flags go to human audit; never block a release or a call
revalidate_when: the judge prompt or model changes
the agent prompt, STT or TTS version changes
a new language group or campaign starts
agreement on the frozen anchor set drops
anchor_set: <frozen anchor set id, for example 200 calls>
